title: USWNT 🇺🇸 vs El Salvador 🇸🇻 Quarterfinals
seo_title: USWNT vs El Salvador Watch Party in Springfield, MO
description: This is a watch party for the US Women's National Team's CONCACAF W Championship quarterfinal against El Salvador, hosted by American Outlaws Springfield MO. Admission is free, and fans gather to cheer on the team as it plays for a spot in the semifinals on its way toward next summer's Women's World Cup. It takes place Friday, November 27, 2026, from 7:30 PM to 9:30 PM at Mumbles1888, 504 E. Commercial Street in Springfield, MO.
